The view sells itself. The website should too.

West Close Cottage looks out over three dales — but every booking still has to come down a phone line. Here's what the site could be doing instead.

What the current site is leaving on the table

Checked against westclosefarmhouse.co.uk as it stands today — your published tariff, your calendar, your stack.

Stays bookable online

The calendar shows a price, then stops. Every booking still lands on the phone or in a contact form.

The only shape a stay can take

Short breaks are offered — but the site says "contact us for prices". That's revenue behind a phone call.

6.2

WordPress version behind it

The 6.2 branch dates to 2023, with Contact Form 7 from the same era. Working, but drifting out of support.

Credit where it's due — the current site is not broken. The theme is properly responsive, the gallery already has 46 photos with a working lightbox, and the availability calendar is accurate and current. The gap isn't looks. It's that nothing on the site can close a booking.
What's possible

Six upgrades that turn browsers into bookings

Not a redecoration. Each of these is a job the site currently hands to a phone call.

Live availability & instant quotes

Guests pick dates and see a real price before they ever pick up the phone — try it below.

Filterable amenities

"Dog-friendly", "log burner", "EV charging" — guests filter for what matters instead of reading a wall of text.

Direct bookings, no commission

Every stay booked on your own site is one an agency doesn't take 15–20% of. That's the whole business case.

Trust signals up front

Guest reviews and a real availability calendar replace "call for last-minute deals".

Interactive walks & location map

The Dales Cycleway, local pubs, Leyburn's shops — plotted, not just listed as bullet points.

Mobile-first, top to bottom

Most guests will book this from a phone. The redesign starts there instead of retrofitting it.

Live demo — try it

Your tariff and your rules, doing the quoting for you

This runs your published rates and your actual letting rules — including the short breaks the current site has to send to voicemail. Change the dates and watch it work.

  • Saturday-to-Saturday weeks, snapped automatically — guests can't book a stay you don't offer
  • Short breaks priced in Low Season & Winter only — try picking August and see the rule fire
  • Dogs declared at the point of booking, exactly as your policy requires

The pitch

Same cottage, same view — a site that finally does the booking for you

Everything here is built from your own photos, your own copy and your published tariff — nothing invented. A production build adds a real booking engine with payment handling, a calendar that syncs both cottages, and a CMS you can update yourselves.
